column1: # Published, external adult height statistics used for Stage B3's descriptive cross-check
# (BUILD_PLAN.md §6 Stage B3) — NOT derived from 1000 Genomes, which has no phenotype data.
# Each 1000 Genomes super-population groups several specific national/ethnic source
# average-height statistics aren't available for every constituent population, so this table
# uses a small set of representative countries per super-population as an approximation —
# itself a limitation to state alongside any comparison, not just a data-availability footnote.
# Source: national survey figures as compiled in Wikipedia's "Average human height by country"
# cites national health-survey and NCD-RisC-derived figures per country (NCD Risk Factor
# Collaboration, "A century of trends in adult human height", eLife 2016;5:e13410). Measurement
# year/method varies by country (noted per row) — these are not from one harmonized survey wave.
